captions: Question 4. You knew this last night.
Now your mind is blank. Your pen just shakes.
The clock gets louder. Everyone else keeps writing.
You close your eyes. “Ya Allah, make it easy.”
That evening. The library. The next chapter open.
Before the first page, two hands raised to Him.
You still study. But you're no longer alone with it.

post.caption:
You revised 300 pages. You never asked Allah once. 🤍

Study hard — and ask the One who opens minds.

“For indeed, with hardship [will be] ease.” (94:5)

Before you study tonight: two rak'ahs, one du'a. You're not alone with it.
